Client service · MedTech Supply Chain

Improve flow without weakening the control environment.

For regulated MedTech operations that need a defensible performance baseline and practical improvement across planning, logistics and control hand-offs.

Problem and symptoms

When the headline measure is not locating the cause.

  • Service measures that do not reflect customer or product reality
  • Material available physically but not usable operationally
  • Control queues treated as unavoidable without journey evidence
  • Quality, finance and operations working from different baselines
  • SKU complexity obscuring the segment that needs action

Business impact

A weak baseline can direct corrective action at the wrong cause. It can also create a traceability problem alongside the original operational issue.

Scope

  • Customer and product service definitions
  • Inventory, SKU and constraint segmentation
  • Control and release hand-offs
  • Supplier and logistics evidence
  • Assumptions, caveats and accountable human review

Approach

Keep product disposition and regulatory judgement with qualified people. Diagnose the operational journey around those controls and make uncertainty explicit before recommending change.

Evidence boundary

No case metric is used without written clearance for the page, wording and context.

Engagement route

Start with a 30-minute Operational Diagnostic conversation. Fees and delivery duration are agreed only after scope approval.

Frequently asked questions

Before the first conversation.

Does this replace quality or regulatory expertise?

No. The work stays within operational evidence, hand-offs and management information. Product disposition and regulatory interpretation remain with qualified functions.

Can patient data be used?

Patient data is not required for an initial conversation and should not be sent. Any later data scope must be explicitly agreed and minimised.

Do you claim certifications or insurance?

No certification, accreditation or insurance claim is made without current documentary evidence.
